motivation: position/response direction regressions can be hidden by lower aggregate loss
existing_loss: preserve merged-refit S2 anchor and paired absolute/response losses and group weights

additional_loss.direction_penalty: squared hinge max(0.5-soft_cosine,0)^2 on strong training responses only
additional_loss.strong_signal: measured position half-difference norm >=10*max(1um,5*zero-replay half-difference norm)

checkpoint_guard.reference: starting checkpoint; per group and amplitude
checkpoint_guard.no_eligible_update: retain starting checkpoint and report failure to improve

boundary: retrospectively designed for next development experiment; regression guards are not control admission criteria; validation is repeatedly used development data
